title: Send Request
help: Send a request message and wait for a response (synchronous request-reply)

value.name: configRef
value.helpTip: The connection to use for the operation.

value.name: destinationName
value.helpTip: Name of the topic or queue to send the request to.

value.name: messageType
value.helpTip: Message type: TEXT, BYTES, or XML. JSON payloads are auto-detected and carried as TEXT.

value.name: requestTimeout
value.helpTip: Maximum time to wait for response in milliseconds (default: 30000).

value.name: deliveryMode
value.helpTip: Delivery mode. DIRECT is valid only for TOPIC destinations (best-effort pub/sub). QUEUE destinations require PERSISTENT or NON_PERSISTENT (guaranteed delivery).

value.name: waitForAck
value.helpTip: Wait for the broker acknowledgement of a PERSISTENT or NON_PERSISTENT request before waiting for the reply. Ignored for DIRECT.

value.name: ackTimeout
value.helpTip: Deadline in milliseconds for the send and the broker acknowledgement of the request. The Request Timeout bounds the whole operation.

value.name: userProperties
value.description: User properties as a JSON array of objects, for example [{"region":"US"},{"priority":"high"}]. Every key of every object is a property. A string stays a string, an integer becomes a long, a decimal a double and a boolean a boolean. A receiver reads each one as the attribute userProp_ followed by the key, for example ${vars.result.attributes.userProp_region}.

value.name: propertyName
value.helpTip: The property key, sent unchanged. A receiver reads it as the attribute userProp_ followed by this key.

value.name: propertyValue
value.helpTip: The property value. The table is sent as a JSON array of objects, one key per object. A string stays a string, an integer becomes a long, a decimal a double and a boolean a boolean.

value.name: contentType
value.helpTip: The content type the reply is read with, for example application/json. It applies to the reply only, the request keeps the content type of the message context. It wins over the type the reply declares. Empty uses the declared type, else the default of its message class. The payload is never inspected. A value without a charset takes the charset the reply declares, else UTF-8.

value.name: responseVariable
value.helpTip: The name of the variable to which the output should be stored.

value.name: overwriteBody
value.helpTip: Replace the Message Body in Message Context with the response.
